# Same-module screen binding host — source only

This four-file host follows the admitted three-file screen plan. It performs no Go build or module copy. `prepare NEW_ID` re-reads the exact existing graph BUILD, module/runtime/source pins, all sealed 72-unit and semantic proof files, the historical v5 RED and both existing actual 192 kHz recorder streams. It writes an explicit `BINDING.json` with schema `same-module-screen-binding-v1`, referencing the existing module paths. It does not forge an old BUILD or runner inventory. All 37 new/current/frozen source inputs are indexed; frozen Go payloads retain `.source` suffixes.

The child is admitted only when it equals a closed literal metadata transformation of the old frozen child. Only proof namespace/schema/source inventory, existing module paths and prerequisite receipt bindings change. The Go screen test, screen-only argument/environment method, shared closed filesystem, output sink and post-exit lifecycle remain the same. The fixture route is removed; both labels reuse actual sealed recorder bytes equal to the accepted same-backend e492 candidate archive. The host imports the old parser and observation admission functions unchanged.

The parent uses the original Node26 argv with no unit heap/stack flags or RSS polling. Its 28-second deadline, 256 KiB combined log cap, 50 ms pipe polling, new session and closed environment match the old screen parent. Every operation from process creation through selector construction/registration and reading is inside owned cleanup. Setup failure kills/reaps the owned child; spawn failure records no child. Primary and cleanup failures, partial logs and exclusive receipts are retained, with direct-child kill fallback on signaling-helper error. EOF, exact screen start/PASS and zero clean-exit failures are required. Original closed filesystem/data caps and 25-second Go watchdog remain unchanged.

`qualify ID steady|peaky` is a future two-child verification command. `measure ID steady|peaky quiet-approved` is a future three-child baseline-before/candidate/baseline-after command, admitted only after actual bound verification bytes and receipts are re-read. Both require separate Chair execution releases; timing additionally requires all-agent quiet acknowledgment. Exclusive child directories prevent retries/overwrites; an active lock prevents overlap. Source preparation and synthetic contracts supply neither release.

All original Tube/Optical settings, finite/repeat order, 64 warm/32 verify/reset/64 warm/32 measured128-frame blocks, source clocks, allocation observations and caps remain unchanged. Means supply no callback maximum, physical deadline, headroom, browser continuity or physical steady-state certificate. Existing 192 kHz steady RED remains open; candidate unselected and cross-target full-state identity UNPROVEN. This private trusted-module host is not a sandbox for untrusted Go code.
